Use this function only for a critical freeze, broken animation, texture, or Mark XI system state.

If the suit is worn, its runtime is fully reset. If the suit is parked, the bound mannequin and any stranded bound components nearby are reconstructed after 3 seconds. Saved durability and power state are preserved where recoverable.

This recovery tool can repair older broken saves, but perfect restoration cannot be guaranteed in every mod-conflict scenario.

Mark XI Suit is developed primarily for single-player.

Because of the way Project Zomboid multiplayer works, and because the suit contains a large number of interconnected systems and components, multiplayer support is currently in beta.

Bugs and errors may occur in multiplayer, including critical issues that can affect your equipment, the suit state, or the safety of your character.

The mod author continues to work on multiplayer updates and fixes, but fully stable operation of the suit in multiplayer cannot currently be guaranteed.

Use the suit in multiplayer at your own risk.
